disclaimer: Illustrative dual-path model (STR short-let AL/Airbnb and LTR arrendamento tradicional) for Lisbon tourist-core. NOI, cash flow and CoC are pre-IRS / pre-AL-tax and not legal, tax, or mortgage advice. IMT and regime depend on buyer profile and property value; mais-valia is out of scope — verify with a lawyer / bank. Soft-market caution: AirDNA city TTM thru Jul 2026 softened (~65% occ / ~$23.1k avg) and ListingOK YoY revenue −11–13%. Dual path: use STR only on already-licensed AL; otherwise model LTR fallback. Ops flag: Alfama/Baixa/Bairro Alto are often RMAL-saturated; STR revenue assumes the unit is already licensed for AL. This is an operating assumption, not a tax conclusion.

assumptions.label: Furniture / fit-out
assumptions.note: Default mid of €5–8k band for compact tourist-core unit. LTR often lower if unfurnished.

assumptions.label: Income mode
assumptions.note: str = short-let AL/Airbnb; ltr = long-let arrendamento. Driven by the mode toggle and draft picker.

assumptions.label: Monthly rent (LTR)
assumptions.note: LTR T0 tourist-core mid €1,000 (€950–1,100); T1 mid €1,300 (€1,200–1,400). Asking vs signed gap often ~20%+.

assumptions.label: Vacancy (months / year)
assumptions.note: Gross annual = rent × 12 × (1 − vacancy/12). Default 1 month (~8%). Market-ready stock may be 3–4%.

assumptions.label: Nightly rate (ADR)
assumptions.source: AirDNA Lisbon overview (data thru Jul 2026; page updated 2026-08-05) + BNBCalc / GuestFavorites size×area + Airbtics (upper only)
assumptions.note: Conservative T0 default €95. AirDNA city: 65% occ, ADR $147, ~$23.1k avg revenue (softer than prior ~$33.9k/70% cite). City ADR is too rich for compact T0; suggest studio/T0 €95–115 stress, market-mid €105–115. Airbtics Alfama ~€113 ADR / 85% occ is upper/optimistic, not global default. Property AirDNA Rentalizer needs paid login/pasted comps.

assumptions.label: Occupancy
assumptions.source: AirDNA Lisbon overview (thru Jul 2026 / updated 2026-08-05) + ListingOK / GuestFavorites / underwriting policy
assumptions.note: Keep conservative default at 55%. AirDNA city occupancy now 65% (thru Jul 2026); ListingOK ~72%; GuestFavorites ~67%; Airbtics 80%+ is upper/optimistic, not a global default. Underwrite market-mid at 60–65% unless the unit has proven history. Soft-market: ListingOK YoY revenue −11–13%.

assumptions.label: Platform fees (Airbnb host)
assumptions.source: Airbnb EEA single host fee ~15.5% (mandatory from 2026-10-13) / Lodgify 2026-08-28
assumptions.note: Default 15.5% host-only fee for EEA from 2026-10-13 (was often ~3% host + guest fee). Legacy split setups may differ — verify current host account.

assumptions.label: Average stay length
assumptions.note: Used to derive turnovers/month from occupancy.

assumptions.label: Cleaning per turnover (owner-paid)
assumptions.note: Model charges the owner every time; conservative if the guest separately pays a cleaning fee.

assumptions.label: Condomínio (monthly)
assumptions.note: Ask agent for exact; elevators / works special assessments extra.

assumptions.label: IMI (annual)
assumptions.source: Proxy — often ~0.3–0.45% of VPT, not purchase price
assumptions.note: VPT-based proxy; replace with caderneta predial / VPT figure when known. Optional quick check: VPT × 0.0035.

assumptions.label: Utilities + Wi‑Fi (monthly)
assumptions.source: STR owner OpEx / LTR usually tenant-paid
assumptions.note: STR default €100/mo (electricity + water + fibre; guest-heavy use can push higher). LTR default €0 — tenant typically pays; editable if marketing inclusive furnished (€30–60 fibre).

assumptions.label: Insurance (life + MRH, monthly)
assumptions.note: Life + multirisk home insurance placeholder; replace with bank/insurer quotes.

assumptions.label: Insurance (annual placeholder)
assumptions.note: Out of scope as a separate input; use insurance_monthly above.

assumptions.label: Management fee
assumptions.note: STR: default 0% self-managed; stress 15–25% full co-host. LTR: default 0% self / optional ~8% remote management of rent.

assumptions.label: IRS rental tax stress — illustrative % of NOI only — not legal Cat. F
assumptions.note: Optional stress only: illustrative % of NOI only — not legal Cat. F. Cat. F treatment is based on taxable rents and depends on facts/regime; default 0 = pre-tax.

assumptions.label: IRS rental tax
assumptions.note: Pre-tax model; use irs_rental_pct only as an optional illustrative stress.

assumptions.label: AL compliance (annual placeholder)
assumptions.note: Out of scope; add verified licensing/compliance costs when known.

assumptions.label: Mais-valia tax
assumptions.note: Sale-side capital-gains / mais-valia tax is excluded from this operating model.

assumptions.label: Loan cap
assumptions.note: Generic ceiling only; no bank names or personal details stored.

assumptions.label: Maintenance / reserves
assumptions.source: STR reserve rule of thumb / LTR % of annual rent
assumptions.note: STR default 8% of gross booking revenue; optional 10% stress for unreformed high-turnover tourist-core stock. LTR default ~7% of annual rent (or ~1% of price). Mode switch applies mode-appropriate default when resetting.

assumptions.label: Loan-to-value (LTV)
assumptions.note: Default 70%; loan recomputes as min(price × LTV, €170,000) until you edit the loan. Alex note: preapproval ceiling €170k.

assumptions.label: Mortgage loan amount
assumptions.note: Default loan = min(purchase price × 70%, €170,000); generic calculator input only. Alex note: preapproval ceiling €170k.

assumptions.label: Mortgage interest rate
assumptions.note: Replace with bank offer; excludes life/building insurance.

assumptions.label: Mortgage term
assumptions.note: Monthly payment via standard amortising formula.
